workflow_runs.name: Bazel (experimental)
workflow_runs.display_title: feat(tui): add Ctrl+O quick toggle between recent models

head_commit.message:
refactor(core): scope runtime model toggle pair as tui config

Rename the runtime `Config` field from `model_toggle_pair` to
`tui_model_toggle_pair` so it matches the existing convention for
TUI-scoped runtime settings while keeping on-disk storage under
`[tui].model_toggle_pair`.

Update TUI consumers/tests to use the scoped runtime field and refresh
`core/config.schema.json` for documentation/schema drift from the added
rustdoc clarifications.
